items.text: Delete the six old course covers under 2026/06 in the Media Library - nothing points at them
Click the NRCS grazing link in the academy resources - machines are blocked from it, a person is not
Decide: delete the 26 archived first-draft lessons? Until then the module list reads 15 of 21
Decide: who is the Lab for - homeschool families, adults, or both? Changes the nine adult-only flags
Erin: check the soap recipe lye weight on soapcalc.net and read the soap and sourdough resource sheets
Decide: does VRBO remit the state tax on farm stays, leaving only Clay tourist tax? Sets DR-15 line D
Decide: retire the Square gift card product now that the printed cards exist
Print a batch of two gift cards, activate one by scanning it, and buy something with it
Confirm the real intro-session list, dates and times with Dan, Susan and Debra - the flyer dates are placeholders and the site waits on this
Chase the head-and-shoulders photos from the six named on page 10 of the Program Overview - due before the next meeting; compose the group shot once they are in
Send Matthew the structure brief for the JV agreement, plus the franchise-law questions from August
Buy a $1 test seat in a workshop - proves checkout, fulfillment, the attendee emails and the revenue ledger end to end
Decide: green-light the Portfolio Suite generator (AI-written, regenerate on changed entries) - the last unbuilt thing a paying customer sees
Decide: switch on the three student nudge emails (begin, idle, area done) in Tools - Email Library, or leave them off
Decide when instructor and franchise applications open - both forms show a hold notice until then
Settle the weekly meeting day - Tuesday or Thursday at 4 so Debra can attend; Dan asked, Debra has to answer
Decide: keep platform access at $27 or raise it - flagged in the critical review as signalling cheap
Waiting on Jeremy: does the Piece Log proposal match his build-log idea, and may the Kraken be the first log
Texting: open the club's Telnyx account, buy one local number, complete 10DLC brand and campaign registration, then hand over the four keys for wp-config.php
Texting: get members to tick 'Text me club announcements' on My Profile, or have the secretary record consent on the Roster screen - nobody can be texted until then
Golf tournament: give me the real date, course and entry price - the product on the Events page is a placeholder and the old site says the tournament is real
Decide: finish the News page (needs a Facebook Page access token) or drop News from the menu
Give the go to lock officers and the treasurer out of wp-admin - The Office on the front end becomes their only door
Delete the test user lrk-rc1 in Users - one click I cannot do from here
Payments: club opens a Square account under its own EIN, the treasurer connects it in WooCommerce > Square, then test one banquet ticket and one refund
Domain: when Phil sends the EPP code for lakeregionkiwanis.org, forward it and I start the transfer to Hostinger the same day (Keith's request went out Sept 16, due Sept 30)
Go-live by end of October: DNS to Hostinger, turn off 'Store coming soon', old site down - after the domain transfer and Square are done
Make sure someone reads info@grandtestimony.com - the Gift-Giver's Guide tells buyers to reply to their receipt for help, and all site mail goes out from that address
Decide: rewrite the 50%-off campaign email - its first line is a legal disclaimer, and 0 of 23 Gazette signups went on to make an account
Decide: put the Gift-Giver's Guide link beside Give Someone Their Story for $5 on the home and Legacy Book pages - page editor, /?gt_guide=giver
Decide: delete Media items 19 and 38 - real photographs with stock-download filenames and no licence on record; nothing uses them now
Next time grandtestimony.com fails on the first try at home, note the ERR_ code at the bottom of the page and tell Claude - the site is fast from the server, so it is the path from your house
Decide: build a demo reset? Today a visitor cannot restart the demo walkthrough without clearing their browser storage
Decide: start the Patchstack security trial that was deferred, or drop it
Decide: hide poll-ad percentages until an ad has about 20 answers - the first person to answer sees 100/0/0, which reads as rigged
Approve a privacy policy update - the site now records location on ad answers, ad clicks and guest votes and the policy does not say so
Monday Sept 21 or after: hPanel > Cron Jobs > View Output on the weekly job (5 0 * * 1) - it now prints a line; ok means the leaderboard cron is proven, FAILED means tell Claude
